'''Baxendahl''' was a being who sold a breeding [[groat]] which turned out to be barren. The being Baxendahl sold the groat to asked [[Ghitsa Dogder]] to mediate the situation, believing her to be a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Simple Tricks">{{StoryCite|story=Simple Tricks|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref>
